review.notes: Triage review of the 198-page document within a fixed time budget. (1) Full structural scan of the whole OCR markdown: all code fences are balanced, no fence swallows headings/tables/images, no 4-backtick fences, no speaker-label headings, and the repeated section names (Results, Metrics, Automated behavioral audit scores) are legitimate same-named sections of different chapters. (2) Automated droppage scan of all 198 pages (normalized 4-gram containment per page, threshold 85%): 37 low-containment pages were triaged; pages 152 and 195-197 are false positives (HTML table cell ordering and code-fenced URL blocklists/test lists that are present in the OCR), page 94 is a near-blank divider. The one systematic real defect is that every page-bottom footnote body was dropped by the OCR while the superscript citation markers survive; all 36 footnote bodies (numbers 1-36) were recovered from the PDF page bottoms, each visually verified on a rendered page crop (110-120 dpi sheet reads of pages 17-197 bottoms), and reinserted after the OCR paragraph containing its marker. Footnote 11 belongs to the Table 8.1.A cell 66.0 and is inserted after the table caption. (3) Line-by-line inspection was limited to the triaged pages and footnote pages listed in pages_reviewed; the remaining prose pages were machine-scanned only. The PDF itself prints 'Claude Opus 5..' with a doubled period on physical p.81, so that reading is source text, not an OCR defect. Footnotes 17 and 22 legitimately print the same ProgramBench citation on physical pp.159 and 169.
